city-of-sorcerers.specific_finding: The summary makes the winner the sorcerer with most points from learned spells, artifacts, allies, defeated monsters and achievements. The contemporary RobertHulston review (Imagine5 August1983 printed18/PDF20) instead describes eighteen research turns followed by a separate arena contest: players secretly locate their havens and must detect and eliminate opposing havens to win. Wizards remain in those havens and have no moving personal counter in the arena. The original Beginner’s Guide independently identifies apprenticeship followed by winning a magical arena battle; its visible common-phase procedure moves controlled monsters, not personal sorcerer pieces. Replacing that two-stage hidden-haven elimination objective with accumulated-item points changes how the game is won. Specific MAJOR against the covered original-game reference only. The separate nineteen/twenty-hex discrepancy is unresolved and the reviewer’s approximate six-turn duration is not treated as a printed rule. Full original manual/card rules remain missing; no full audit or summary body repair.
